premise.claim: Two independent implementations of 'recover the owner GroupVersionKind when TypeMeta is empty' (#6138's local datasetControllerOwnerReference and #6139's scheme-based GenerateOwnerReferenceFromObject) do not agree on semantics; neither fix covers the other's callers.
premise.evidence: On base e0fc4c18, datasetControllerOwnerReference(TypeMeta{Kind:Dataset, APIVersion:'data.fluid.io/'}) returns apiVersion 'data.fluid.io/' (version missing) while the shared helper returns 'data.fluid.io/v1alpha1' — results/layer1-base-premise-canary.txt; the same canary flips to FAIL on the PR head (converged) — results/layer1-head-canary-flip.txt. Integration layer: a real API server (envtest) rejects the old output with 'version must not be empty' — results/layer2-envtest-apiserver-validation.txt

liveNote: L3 skipped by design of this review round (no KUBECONFIG layer). The observable signal would be the dataset controller creating/adopting a ThinRuntime for a reference dataset whose TypeMeta apiVersion lost its version part; the issue scope states this shape is not reachable from current call sites, and envtest (L2) already proves the API-server validation half.
